# ESP Mod v2.0.2 

## Changes from v2.0.1

- Skip chunks entirely outside Box Range before checking individual cached blocks. The existing per-block range check still determines which boxes are drawn.
- Reuse the drawing style for each block type in a chunk, instead of creating a style for every box.
- Avoid creating empty chunk caches for untracked block changes, and remove caches when their last match disappears.

The v2.0.1 chunk-boundary update fix and existing presets, colors, settings and dependency requirements are retained. Sections without tracked blocks are still skipped during scans, with one chunk scanned per tick.

## Validation

The build and assertion self-check pass, covering chunk-boundary updates, cache cleanup, negative coordinates, exact range boundaries, and a grid comparison confirming the chunk filter does not reject in-range blocks. No FPS improvement has been measured on lower-end hardware, and these rendering changes have not yet been visually checked in Minecraft.

## Installation

Requires Minecraft **26.3**, Java **25+**, Fabric Loader **0.19.5+**, and Fabric API for **26.3** (built against **0.161.0+26.3**). Mod Menu **21.0.0** is optional.

# ESP Mod v2.0.1 - Block ESP patch

This patch addresses missing ore boxes at chunk boundaries reported in v2.0.0. Minecraft and dependency requirements remain the same.

## Changes from v2.0.0

- Placing or removing tracked blocks updates the cache immediately, including in loaded chunks awaiting their first scan. Previously, these updates were discarded until the chunk was scanned.
- Changing tracked types or selecting a preset keeps existing results instead of blanking the cache. Nearby chunks are rescanned first.
- Block changes are captured through the client state's dirty-block hook, including changes that bypass the notification flags used by the previous hook.

The box-range setting still applies to block and entity boxes. Entity ESP uses a separate per-frame entity lookup and was unaffected by this cache issue.

Requires Minecraft **26.3**, Java **25+**, Fabric Loader **0.19.5+**, and Fabric API for **26.3** (built against **0.161.0+26.3**). Mod Menu **21.0.0** is optional.

# ESP Mod v2.0.0

This update brings Minecraft 26.3 support, block ESP, custom box colors, and a revised configuration menu. It follows the v1.0.0 release, which was named Spectral ESP and targeted Minecraft 26.1.2.

## v1.0.0 vs. v2.0.0

| Feature | v1.0.0 | v2.0.0 |
|---|---|---|
| Minecraft version | 26.1.2 | 26.3 |
| ESP targets | Entities | Entities and selected blocks |
| Entity selection | Search the full registry and toggle types | Add, toggle, recolor, or remove tracked types |
| Entity box colors | Fixed player, mob, and other-entity colors | Custom colors per entity type |
| Entity presets | Players, Mobs, Vehicles, Technical, All Entities bulk toggles | Players, Mobs, Vehicles, Decorative, Projectiles, Items & Drops, Mods, Other; existing settings are preserved |
| Block presets | None | Ores, Containers, Valuables, and individual block selection |
| Box range | No configurable limit | 8–512 blocks or automatic render distance |
| Toggle key | `G` | Unbound by default; set it in the menu or Controls |
| Saved settings | `spectral-esp.json`; master enabled state not saved | Separate entity/block configs; enabled states saved |

## Features and cleanup

- Entity and block box colors can be chosen with RGB sliders or a `#RRGGBB` hex value, with a live color preview.
- The master toggle controls entity and block ESP together. Entity outlines and hitboxes have separate Show/Hide controls.
- Tracked invisible entities can show glowing outlines. Outline colors continue to follow Minecraft's normal behavior.
- Menus use Minecraft's native keyboard navigation, focus, dragging, and narration handling. Escape returns to the previous menu or cancels color selection/key rebinding.
- Block scanning processes loaded chunks gradually on the client thread. Scanned positions update when blocks change and are removed when chunks unload.
- Entity lookups use registered entity types directly. Unused code, redundant caches, and unnecessary concurrent collections were removed.
- Config saves finish writing before replacing the existing file. Invalid files are logged and backed up, duplicate/invalid entries are filtered, and the saved box range is constrained to its supported values.
- Input handling and entity box submission were updated for Minecraft 26.3.

releases.notes:
ESP Mod v1.0.0
--------------------

### ESP Display

- **Outline ESP** - glowing entity outlines visible through walls
- **Hitbox ESP** - colored wireframe boxes rendered through walls
- Players shown in red, mobs in orange, other entities in yellow

### Entity Presets

- Quick toggles for **Players**, **Mobs**, **Vehicles**, **Technical**, and **All Entities**

### Advanced Entity Settings

- Full scrollable list of every registered entity type grouped by category
- Search bar to filter by name
- Per-entity **Show/Hide** toggle

### Config Menu

- Open in-game with `\`
- Rebind keys directly in the config screen
- `G` toggles ESP on/off
- Mod Menu support included
